transaction_extraction.task: Extract transaction data from Postal Savings Bank of China (PSBC) account statement

column_descriptions.transaction_time: Column 1 - '交易时间'. IMPORTANT: May contain ONLY date (e.g., '2024-12-26') or BOTH date and time (e.g., '2024-12-26 02:10:50'). Extract the FULL content accurately as seen.
column_descriptions.post_date: Column 2 - '记账日期'. Usually a date (e.g., '2024-12-26').
column_descriptions.balance: Column 5 - '余额'. Account balance after transaction.
column_descriptions.serial_number: Column 12 - '交易流水号'. Alphanumeric or numeric code.
column_descriptions.global_route_no: Column 13 - '全局路由号'. Alphanumeric or numeric code.

extraction_rules: Extract data row by row from left to right
For '交易时间', capture the full string (including HH:mm:ss if present)
If an amount column is empty, use empty string ''
Maintain the exact format seen in the image for all fields
merge_rules: Counterparty name or account may span multiple lines - merge vertically
Remove artificial spaces from line breaks during merging
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

summary_extraction.task: Extract summary information from Postal Savings Bank of China (PSBC) statement first page
summary_extraction.location: Summary info is in the top area of the page
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
